response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT p.arcregistry, p.fundflux, ss.boxx * 1.0 / ss.boxz AS ratio
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  WHERE ss.boxx IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.boxz <> 0
), project_ratios AS (
  SELECT arcregistry, fundflux, AVG(ratio) AS ratio
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY arcregistry, fundflux
), scored AS (
  SELECT arcregistry, fundflux, ratio,
         ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY fundflux) AS margin
  FROM project_ratios
)
SELECT arcregistry AS project_id, fundflux AS funding_source, ratio, margin
FROM scored
ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: For a project with multiple spatial records, its ratio is the simple average of the individual boxx/boxz ratios; zero boxz is excluded as an undefined ratio. Each project is then compared with the simple average of those per-project ratios in its funding source.

alternatives.interpretation: If “simple average ratio” means average the project’s boxx and boxz values across its records first, then divide those averages, compare that project ratio against the funding-source average of those project ratios.
alternatives.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT p.arcregistry, p.fundflux, ss.boxx, ss.boxz
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  WHERE ss.boxx IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL
), project_ratios AS (
  SELECT arcregistry, fundflux,
         AVG(boxx) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(boxz), 0) AS ratio
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY arcregistry, fundflux
), scored AS (
  SELECT arcregistry, fundflux, ratio,
         ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY fundflux) AS margin
  FROM project_ratios
)
SELECT arcregistry AS project_id, fundflux AS funding_source, ratio, margin
FROM scored
ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
